name: AssayIdentifier
label: Assay identifier
description: An assay identifier is an identifier that identifies some assay (analysis). (AFR:0001979)

name: AssayType
label: Assay type
description: The specific type of laboratory test or analytical procedure performed on a bio-specimen mounted on a glass slide. It defines the staining or labeling technique applied to the specimen to reveal specific structural, molecular, or cellular features. (NCIT:C189101)

name: BelongsToBiospecimen
label: Belongs to biospecimen
description: Reference to the biospecimen (e.g. FFPE block, slide) that was the physical input to this slide preparation assay. (OBI:0000293)

name: PrecedesTheStudy
label: Precedes the study
description: Reference to the subsequent imaging study or digital whole-slide scanning event for which this prepared slide serves as the direct physical input. (SIO:000248)

name: BiomarkerType
label: Biomarker type
description: A classification of the type of biomolecule or biological component that the assay targets, labels, or detects. It characterizes whether the biomarker is, for example, a protein, nucleic acid, carbohydrate, lipid, or inorganic substance. (NCIT:C201359)

name: SectionThickness
label: Section thickness
description: A measurement of the thickness of a sectioned slice (of tissue or mineral or other substance), expressed in micrometers (µm). (NCIT:C176286)

name: BiomarkerSpatialLocalization
label: Biomarker spatial localization
description: The subcellular or structural location within a tissue or cell where the biomarker is expressed or detected. (GO:0051641)

name: PathogenType
label: Pathogen type
description: Identification of the specific type of pathogen among the listed categories e.g. 'Virus','Viroid','Bacterium'... (EVORAO:pathogenType)

name: DyeName
label: Dye name
description: The neutral or synthetic colored substance used for staining specific tissues or cellular components. (SNOMED:703857004)

name: CounterLabeling
label: Counter labeling
description: The counter-labeling technique used to highlight specific cellular or tissue structures, serving as a complementary method to the primary labeling for analysis (SNOMED:703857004)

name: AntibodyName
label: Antibody name
description: The vendor-stated name of an antibody used to detect and visualize the presence of an antigen. (XCO:0000194)
